{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders with non-null revenue
completed_valid = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['revenue'].notna())]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_valid['revenue'].mean()

# Output the result
mean_revenue"}
